items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: That's what I just did, Matoya and David Jones.

ctx.x: Telling about melliform, what a different tone he gave and all that. Who was in your band at the Palace Dance Hall?
That's what I just did, Matoya and David Jones.
Oh, that was your band. Matoya was a leader? Yeah. And you were the manager. I see. Well, did that band play the same kind of music you played at the Home of the Inn?
